title: Liouville theorems for conformal $Q$-curvature equations
summary: In this paper, we study the non-existence of positive solutions for the following conformal $Q$-curvature equation \begin{equation*} (-Δ)^σu = K(x) u^{\frac{n+2σ}{n-2σ}} \quad \text{in } \mathbb{R}^n, \end{equation*} where $σ\in (0, n/2)$ is a real number. When $σ=1$, this equation reduces to the well-known scalar curvature equation arising from the prescribed scalar curvature problem. For general $σ\in (0, n/2)$, it appears in the study of prescribing $Q$-curvature. We establish Liouville theorems under various assumptions on the $Q$-curvature $K(x)$ by developing a unified approach…
